\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Influence}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.Influence
\section{Overview}
Hypercontractivity bounds stable coordinate influences and the low Fourier levels of indicator functions. The level-one estimate has the sharp logarithmic coefficient obtained from linear correlations.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Indicator noise stability]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.indicator_stability_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeIndicator, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.setIndicator, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.small_set_expansion, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.volume, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and $0<\rho\le1$. Then under the uniform cube law $\mathbb E[fT_\rho f]\le(\mathbb Ef)^{2/(1+\rho)}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Indicator correlation with linear forms]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.indicator_linear_form_sq_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.indicator_innerProduct_le_of_mgf, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.rademacher_mgf_le, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ have uniform mean $\alpha>0$, and let $a_i\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_ia_i^2=1$. Then $\big(\mathbb E[f(x)\sum_i a_i(-1)^{x_i}]\big)^2\le2\alpha^2\log(1/\alpha)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Noisy influence and derivative norm]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noisyInfluence_eq_sq_norm_derivative}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.fourierCoeff_derivative, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_compose, BooleanAnalysis.derivative, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct_self_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.l2Norm, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp_self_adjoint, BooleanAnalysis.stability_formula, KKL.noisyInfluence}
\difficulty{5}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $i\in[n]$, and $\rho\ge0$. Then $I_i^{(\rho)}(f)=\|T_{\sqrt\rho}D_if\|_2^2$, where $D_if(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Positive derivative moments]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.derivative_abs_moment_eq_influence}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.derivative_sq_eq_abs_of_pmOne, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.influence_eq_expect_derivative_sq, BooleanAnalysis.derivative, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $i\in[n]$, and $p>0$. Then $\mathbb E|D_if|^p=I_i(f)$, where $D_if(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Stable influence power bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.stableInfluence_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.derivative_abs_moment_eq_influence, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.general_one_function_hypercontractivity, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noisyInfluence_eq_sq_norm_derivative, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.influence_eq_expect_derivative_sq, BooleanAnalysis.derivative, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.l2Norm, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp, KKL.noisyInfluence}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $i\in[n]$, and $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $I_i^{(\rho)}(f)\le I_i(f)^{2/(1+\rho)}$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[One-third stable influence]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.stableInfluence_one_third}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.stableInfluence_le, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, KKL.noisyInfluence}
\difficulty{1}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $i\in[n]$. Then $I_i^{(1/3)}(f)\le I_i(f)^{3/2}$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Weighted low-level Fourier bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.weighted_fourierWeightUpTo_le_stability}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.fourierWeightUpTo, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp, BooleanAnalysis.stability_formula}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $\rho^k\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)^2\le\mathbb E[fT_\rho f]$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Indicator exponent estimate]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.indicator_rpow_le_sq_mul_exp}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
For every $0<\alpha\le1$ and $\rho\ge0$, $\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}\le\alpha^2\exp(2\rho\log(1/\alpha))$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Level bound parameter optimization]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.level_k_optimization}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.indicator_rpow_le_sq_mul_exp}
\difficulty{4}
Let $0<\alpha\le1$, $W\in\mathbb R$, and a positive integer $k$ satisfy $k\le2\log(1/\alpha)$. If $\rho^kW\le\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}$ for every $0<\rho\le1$, then $W\le((2e/k)\log(1/\alpha))^k\alpha^2$.
\end{lemma}
